en-US.description:
Tomos is an unofficial client for the Polish Librus Synergia platform, built with Flutter to bring clarity to grades, messages, attendance, homework, and school information for students and parents.

Tomos is not affiliated with Librus. It is actively developed and may contain bugs or visual differences between screens as features and design evolve.

Features:

  • Unified Feed & Calendar: Weekly and daily schedule views, school events, holidays, teacher absences, and substitutions.
  • Grades: View numeric and descriptive grades with weights, skills, categories, and subject grouping.
  • Attendance & Justifications: Attendance statistics with custom grouping rules and absence justifications.
  • Homework & Trips: Track assignments, upcoming school trips, and school year milestones.
  • Messaging: Read, send, and organize messages with tags, drafts, and attachments.
  • Accounts, Security & Theming: Multiple user accounts, encrypted credential storage, auto-login, and customizable themes.
